claim_scope: Development-only quality-value architecture and auxiliary-objective screen over identical full candidate support; the fixed test partition remains locked.

selection.primary_metric_description: Validation quality regret under exact validity and B/Q_MM qubit-budget constraints.
selection.auxiliary_policy: Residual-connectivity and robustness losses may regularize representation learning but never select the winning architecture.
selection.paper_checkpoint_policy: Freeze and evaluate all four seed checkpoints of the winning configuration; report the aggregate across seeds.
selection.deployment_checkpoint_policy: The lowest-validation-regret seed is the deployment checkpoint only, not the sole paper estimate.

execution.design: With four seeds as the innermost axis, cell-index parity assigns seeds 0 and 2 to Apollo and seeds 1 and 3 to Goose for every architecture-objective configuration. Every architecture and objective variant is balanced 50/50 across sites, and every configuration has exactly two seeds on each site.
